expected.title: Alder Avenue closure for water main replacement
expected.summary: Alder Avenue will be closed between 5th Street and 9th Street from 2 June to 20 June for water main replacement. Traffic will be detoured via Birch Road and bus route 14 will skip three stops. Residents keep driveway access outside work hours.
key_points: Closure between 5th Street and 9th Street, 2 June to 20 June
Work hours 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays
